title: smtp action
description: Sends the message as an email over TLS (smtp: STARTTLS, required; smtps: TLS from the start) and passes it on unchanged. The body is the email's text, or an attachment to emailBody.

to.title: To
to.description: Recipients, separated by commas or semicolons

replyTo.title: Reply-To
replyTo.description: Address replies go to; "" for none

subject.title: Subject
subject.description: Subject; the message's header subject overrides it

exchangeBodyAs.title: Send body as
exchangeBodyAs.description: body: the body is the email's text; attachment: the body is attached to the text emailBody

emailBody.title: Email text
emailBody.description: Text of an email whose body goes as attachment; setting it attaches the body

contentType.title: Content-Type
contentType.description: Content-Type of the body; defaults to the message's, else text/plain

password.title: Password
password.description: PLAIN password; env DIF_SMTP_PASSWORD (or its _FILE companion). No password or token means no login

accessToken.title: Access token
accessToken.description: OAuth2 access token (XOAUTH2 login); "" for none

trustStoreFile.title: Trust store
trustStoreFile.description: PKCS#12 keystore with the certificates to trust; "" trusts the system's roots

trustStorePassword.title: Trust store password
trustStorePassword.description: Trust store password; env DIF_TRUSTSTORE_PASSWORD (or its _FILE companion)

timeout.title: Timeout
timeout.description: Milliseconds the whole exchange with the server may take

authenticationType.title: Authentication
authenticationType.description: Accepted for compatibility; the login follows from password or accessToken

fromEmailPreference.title: From preference
fromEmailPreference.description: Accepted for compatibility; has no effect

tenantDbName.title: Tenant
tenantDbName.description: Accepted for compatibility; has no effect
